explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1180 with the positive answer. For each ε > 0 there is C such that, for every prime p, every residue mod p is a sum of at most C inverses n^{-1} with 1 ≤ n ≤ p^ε. It holds for all primes, which is fine for fixed ε: the finitely many small p with p^ε < 2 can be handled with C ≥ p - 1 copies of 1^{-1}.
